# Feature: Current tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #42 (Current tile) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: water pushes you downstream. Unique: forced drift that only applies while swimming. Useful: one-way water routes and exits you can be carried past. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** water pushes you downstream.

**So that** one-way water routes and exits you can be carried past.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Current tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-42-current-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: the current runs past a banked exit toward deep water. A player who aims straight at the exit is carried one tile past it on every move and ends up swimming beyond it, so the retry teaches that the swim is aimed upstream of where they want to land. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: While you are on water with a life preserver, the current carries you one tile downstream at the start of each move, then you make your own move
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Banks and islands are the exits, and you can be carried past them

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Current tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-42-current-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #42.
